records.title: 10-K
records.text: Our software and products revenue was 46% of our total revenues for fiscal 2022, 45% in fiscal 2021 and 41% in fiscal 2020.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: During fiscal 2022, we continued to focus on subscription and other recurring revenue arrangements and began generating revenue from the renewals of subscription licenses sold in prior years.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: •Fiscal 2022: net income adjusted for the impact of non-cash charges, increases in deferred revenue and accrued expenses, partially offset by increases in accounts receivable and deferred commissions.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: The gross margin of our services revenue was 76% for fiscal 2022, 79% for fiscal 2021 and 78% for fiscal 2020.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: To the extent the U.S. dollar weakens against foreign currencies, the translation of these foreign currency denominated transactions generally results in increased revenue, operating expenses and income from operations for our non-U.S. operations.
